tools.name: prowlarr-indexers
tools.description: Configured indexers: id, name, protocol, enabled flag, priority, capabilities.

tools.name: prowlarr-indexer-status
tools.description: Indexers currently disabled by failures: indexerId, most recent failure, and when Prowlarr will retry. Empty list = all indexers healthy.

tools.name: prowlarr-search
tools.description: Search all enabled indexers for releases (what Sonarr/Radarr would see). Returns title, indexer, size, seeders, age, download URL. Use to check whether a release exists at all before blaming Sonarr/Radarr.
tools.filter: [.[] | {title, indexer, size, seeders, leechers, age, publishDate, protocol, categories: [.categories[]?.name], infoUrl}]

tools.name: prowlarr-applications
tools.description: Apps Prowlarr syncs indexers to (Sonarr, Radarr...) and their sync level.

tools.name: prowlarr-health
tools.description: Prowlarr health warnings/errors. Empty list = healthy.

tools.name: prowlarr-system-status
tools.description: Prowlarr version, start time and OS.
